answer: When k bonded identities equivocate on the same conflicting claims, the protocol detects their correlation and applies pairwise penalties, so liability grows as O(k²), not merely with each signer. Escrow seizure and asymmetric depreciation then compound losses across repeated or coordinated violations, making the swarm’s capital loss exponential upon detection; splitting stake among names offers no refuge, whether claims cross an ocean, a glacier, or a forge.
